title: test(qa-scenarios): add the order_to_cash mid-tier scenario card
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D92W26tBPQgYaQxn6AjhUbM)_
Fixes #30477
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:新增「订单到收款」中档场景卡(8 个对象:员工、客户、产品、销售订单、订单明细、发票、收款、跟进活动;折扣审批加逾期催收自动化;3 个角色其中 2 个按行限定;1 张应收账龄报表;120 张订单跨 7–10 月;10 道问数、6 个写操作、5 个 agent 动作),并配一份只属于这张卡的真值测试。
- **为什么改**:落实 cloud#3600 九个场景中的订单到收款场景,让 AI 建应用、问数、代办写操作都有一张能用代码判分的销售到财务闭环卡。
- **风险与回滚**:只加测试数据和测试,所在包私有、不发布,运行时零改动,也不碰任何共享文件;回滚即删两个新文件。
- **先看**:① `docs/qa/scenarios/order_to_cash.json` 的 `run.questions` 与 `run.operations`;② `packages/qa/scenarios/test/order-to-cash.test.ts` 的 `EXPECTED_TRUTHS` 与 `EXPECTED_PERSONA_TRUTHS`;③ 同文件的种子一致性用例(发票、收款、账龄与催收规则)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`,预期 5 个测试文件、70 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `docs/qa/scenarios/order_to_cash.json` (new): the 订单到收款 order-to-cash mid-tier card.
  - Eight objects: `employee`, `account`, `product`, `sales_order`, `order_line`, `invoice`, `payment` and `activity` (the account's follow-up stream, its own records with lookups to the account, the invoice and the owner, never typed into the account).
  - The flows: an order with a line discounted above 10% is routed to the owner's sales manager (`approver`, `approved_on`), and an invoice 15 days past due and not fully paid gets a collection call for the AR clerk.
  - Three personas: `sales_rep` (e03, own accounts; no payment object, no product cost) and `sales_manager` (e01, team east; no payment bank reference) carry a row scope; `ar_clerk` (e09) sees everything but product cost.
  - Seed: 120 orders dated July to October 2026, plus 240 lines, 95 invoices, 72 payments and 64 activities. The arithmetic rule that generated it is stated in the card's `$comment`, so every truth can be worked by hand. Receivables are as of `asOf` 2026-10-31: one account has paid nothing, one pays half on the due date, one pays 20 days late.
  - Run half: 10 questions, 6 operations and 5 agent actions (one confirm-gated); `iterate` adds credit notes.
- `packages/qa/scenarios/test/order-to-cash.test.ts` (new): this card's own test file.
  - It pins all 10 computed truths and the 8 per-persona truths against hand-worked values, with the derivations written beside the pins.
  - It asserts the mid-tier floor, and checks the seed against its own rule: line amounts, order totals, approval routing, one invoice per fulfilled order, the payment roll-up, balance, status and aging bucket, and the collection calls.
  - It checks that each write's declared outcome agrees with the seed (the targeted rows' state, the totals, the open balance the overpayment exceeds).
  - It shows that a wrong seed cell and a wrong truth spec in a fixture copy go red against those pins.

## Tests

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`: 5 files, 70 tests passed (64 before this card, 6 new). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck`: exit 0, after building the closure with `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build`.

The pinned values were worked from the seed rule by a script that implements the business rule directly (it never reads the card's truth specs or calls the loader), then matched against the loader's computed truths: every pin agreed on the first run. The ranking, aging, subscription and per-persona derivations are written out by hand beside their pins.

## Acceptance notes

- **File name.** The card is `order_to_cash.json`, not `order-to-cash.json` as the issue spells it. A card's `id` must be a snake_case machine name and equal the file's basename, so a hyphenated basename cannot load. The test file follows the merged sibling's spelling, `order-to-cash.test.ts`.
- **No shared file touched.** The travel-expense card's PR made `test/library.test.ts` assert only the three control cards and moved per-card pins to each card's own file, so this PR edits neither `library.test.ts` nor the README. Sibling cards no longer conflict with it.
- **README spelling.** `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` "Adding a card" step 3 names the pin file `test/ID.test.ts`, while its model and this card use a hyphenated basename. An observation only; the README is unchanged here.
- **No schema field for some floor items.** The approval flow, the automation, "declarative preferred" and a report as distinct from a dashboard have no field in the schema. The card states them in `prompt.detailed` (zh and en) and in `capabilities`, seeds the approval on `sales_order` (`approver`, `approved_on`) and the automation's collection calls as `activity` rows, and declares the report under `expect.dashboards`. Nothing in the loader grades them.
- **Seven operation kinds, six operations.** `order_from_text` covers two of them: entry from free text with lines, and the multi-step chain (create the order, add two lines, submit it, route it to the manager). The workflow step is `approve_discount`; its progress query is the question `so_0120_waiting_on`.
- **Two writes on SO-0110.** `rep_approves_own_discount` (refused) is listed before `approve_discount` (applied). A refused write changes nothing, so both outcomes hold whether a runner grades each write against the seed or applies the writes in order.
- **Created rows matched by `where`.** A `where` cannot name the new order's id, so `order_from_text` locates the order by account and today's date and each line by product, quantity and discount; no seeded row matches any of them. The lines are therefore not tied to the new order in the post-state.
- **Stored aging bucket.** `invoice.aging_bucket` is a formula on today in the built app; the seed stores its value as of `asOf`, and the test holds every bucket to the due date.
- **Capability tags.** `approvals.dynamic-approver-routing` and `automation.time-relative-trigger` are checklist items; the other tags follow the existing cards' wording. The loader checks the area half only.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/scenarios` is `private: true` and nothing else moves, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`, as the travel-expense card's PR did.
- **Unreachable references.** The domain is designed from the card text and general business knowledge alone; objectstack-ai/cloud#3567 was not read.
